reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice, adhering strictly to the no-sales-CTA brief and self-built demo positioning.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure and clear plain-language framing of data cleaning as a boundary condition rather than a tool feature, making qualifications easily understood.
